mapper.select:
SELECT st.storage_id, pr.product_name, pr.product_type, ro.return_request, op.operate_status, op.operate_time, us.user_name FROM storage AS st LEFT JOIN operate AS op ON st.storage_id = op.storage_id LEFT JOIN product AS pr ON st.product_id = pr.product_id LEFT JOIN return_order AS ro ON st.return_order_num = ro.return_order_num LEFT JOIN user AS us ON op.operator_id = us.user_id
AND op.operate_time BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product (product_id, product_name, product_type, original_price) VALUES (#{product.productID},#{product.productName},#{product.productType},#{product.originalPrice});
mapper.select: SELECT st.storage_id, st.product_id, st.return_order_num, pr.product_name, pr.product_type, pr.original_price, ro.reason_of_return, ro.return_request, ro.postcode, op.operate_id, op.operate_status, op.operate_time, op.operator_id, us.user_id, us.user_name FROM storage AS st LEFT JOIN operate AS op ON st.storage_id = op.storage_id LEFT JOIN product AS pr ON st.product_id = pr.product_id LEFT JOIN return_order AS ro ON st.return_order_num = ro.return_order_num LEFT JOIN user AS us ON op.operator_id = us.user_id WHERE st.storage_id = #{storageID};
